recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not add DiagnosticReport.partOf for FHIR-50887; any remaining concerns about Procedure.report, workflow-pattern mappings, or circular-reference guidance should continue under separate workflow tickets.
issue_request: FHIR-50887 asked to add DiagnosticReport.partOf so DiagnosticReport could document the procedure in which the report was created using the event pattern. The final status is Resolved - No Change / Not Persuasive.
initial_application: No source-changing application was required. The Jira resolution explicitly cites FHIR-50866: because OO kept DiagnosticReport.procedure, adding DiagnosticReport.partOf was not persuasive.
additional_context: Patient Care minutes on 2025-07-24 recorded concerns that moving DiagnosticReport.procedure to DiagnosticReport.partOf did not fit the semantics of partOf. OO on FHIR minutes on 2025-09-12 record that the group was keeping DiagnosticReport.procedure, and OO Main minutes on 2025-10-23 list FHIR-50887 in the Not Persuasive block vote approved 8-0-2.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current active source has DiagnosticReport.procedure with performed-procedure wording, has DiagnosticReport.basedOn for requested services, and has no DiagnosticReport.partOf element.
